surfaceRules.rawLayer: Never delete raw endpoint evidence from artifacts. Native-free reclassification affects the declared game model only; every conflict remains counted and inspectable.
surfaceRules.floor: Keep v1 estimated commonY=0 and floorUncertainty=null; no FARO correction or widened band.
surfaceRules.positiveBodyHeightCandidates: Same raw point-extents test above+.03 and below1.75, not a9cm exclusion. Query corresponding native keys and retain known/occupied/probability/logOdds/hitScans/freeScans.
surfaceRules.occupied: Any corresponding upstream occupied node blocks the10cm cell.
surfaceRules.unknown: Unknown native state for any raw positive candidate remains blocked/unknown; it is not converted to free.
surfaceRules.freeReclassification: A raw positive candidate stops obstructing only if ALL actual associated native keys are known-free, have freeScans > 0, and have hitScans > 0 confirming the measured endpoint association. This is observed-ray evidence, not disappearance or missing detection.
surfaceRules.supportContradiction: Raw below-floor contradiction in the frozen v1 band remains support-invalid in this first v2 cut, even if an occupancy score later becomes free; no stair/drop erasure.
surfaceRules.verticalCoverage: Every one of the original90finite volume samples must satisfy original processed-depth observed-free projection AND query to a native known-free node with freeScans>0. Unknown/occupied samples leave clearance=null.
surfaceRules.priority: Native occupied or unknown-positive and support contradictions override free samples. No SurfaceCell is made traversable by probability alone.
surfaceRules.export: Identical NavigationSurface JSON schema; floor0 ornull, clearance1.75 ornull, blocked, floorUncertainty:null. Recast receives only eligible support quads; actual native Surface validates footprint/height/sweep.
surfaceRules.minimumGeometryCaveat: 5cm voxels/10cm cells/finite samples and3cm floor band do not prove preservation of every tiny/thin/drop geometry. Detailed reference scorer remains independent.
surfaceRules.coverageRecomputation: The v1 artifact sampled only13v1eligible cells. Recompute the SAME frozen90sample/reprojection rule over every newly v2eligible cell using all294original frames; do not reinterpret absent old rows as coverage or omit the rule.
surfaceRules.supportPriorLimitation: The controlled first v2 comparison retains the exact v1 four-quadrant floor prior. A ground-band voxel later marked native-free is reported as a conflict diagnostic but does not change that prior in this cut. Old floor evidence is NOT current support or stair/drop safety. The fixed below-floor contradiction band does not detect every deeper drop. No game clearance or arrival may be called physical safety.
